country.match: Match each city to its country.
country.odd: Three of these cities are in {value}. Which one isn't?

rows.label: New York City
rows.description: most populous city in the United States
rows.hook: is famous for the Statue of Liberty, Broadway shows and towering skyscrapers

rows.label: Singapore
rows.description: sovereign island country and city-state in maritime Southeast Asia
rows.hook: is one of the world's busiest shipping ports and financial hubs

rows.label: Hong Kong
rows.description: city and special administrative region of China
rows.hook: is famous for its dense skyline of skyscrapers packed against green mountains

rows.label: London
rows.description: capital and largest city of England and the United Kingdom
rows.hook: is home to Big Ben and Tower Bridge along a famous river

rows.label: Berlin
rows.description: federated state, capital and largest city of Germany
rows.hook: is home to a famous gate that once stood beside a wall splitting the city in two

rows.label: Tokyo
rows.description: capital and largest city of Japan
rows.hook: is famous for neon-lit streets, sushi and futuristic technology

rows.label: Istanbul
rows.description: largest city in Turkey
rows.hook: is the only major city that sits on two continents at once

rows.label: Melbourne
rows.description: capital city of Victoria, Australia
rows.hook: is famous for its coffee culture and colorful street art laneways

rows.label: Mumbai
rows.description: capital city in Maharashtra, India
rows.hook: is home to Bollywood, the giant Hindi-language film industry

rows.label: Dubai
rows.description: most populous city in the United Arab Emirates and the capital of the Emirate of Dubai
rows.hook: is home to the world's tallest building and man-made palm-shaped islands

rows.label: Mexico City
rows.description: capital and largest city of Mexico
rows.hook: was built atop the ruins of an ancient Aztec capital

rows.label: Shanghai
rows.description: provincial-level municipality in China
rows.hook: is famous for its futuristic skyline along a historic waterfront

rows.label: Beijing
rows.description: capital city of China
rows.hook: is home to a vast ancient imperial palace complex

rows.label: Jakarta
rows.description: capital and largest city of Indonesia
rows.hook: is one of the fastest-sinking big cities in the world

rows.label: Moscow
rows.description: capital and most populous city of Russia
rows.hook: is home to the onion-domed towers of a famous fortified square

rows.label: Sydney
rows.description: capital city of New South Wales, Australia
rows.hook: is famous for its sail-shaped opera house and harbor bridge

rows.label: Saint Petersburg
rows.description: federal city and former capital of Russia
rows.hook: is famous for grand palaces and canals, and is called the Venice of the North

rows.label: Guangzhou
rows.description: capital city of Guangdong Province, China
rows.hook: has been a major trading port for foreign merchants for centuries

rows.label: Delhi
rows.description: megacity and union territory of India
rows.hook: is home to an ancient red fort and bustling historic bazaars

rows.label: Bangkok
rows.description: capital of Thailand
rows.hook: is famous for ornate golden temples and bustling floating markets

rows.label: Ho Chi Minh City
rows.description: largest city in Vietnam
rows.hook: is famous for its French colonial buildings and a sea of motorbikes

rows.label: Bengaluru
rows.description: capital city of Karnataka state in India
rows.hook: is called the Silicon Valley of its country for its booming tech industry

rows.label: Kuala Lumpur
rows.description: federal territory and capital city of Malaysia
rows.hook: is home to soaring twin towers that once stood as the world's tallest

rows.label: Seoul
rows.description: capital and largest city of South Korea
rows.hook: is famous for K-pop culture and futuristic technology

rows.label: Shenzhen
rows.description: city in China
rows.hook: grew from a small fishing village into a booming tech metropolis

rows.label: Kolkata
rows.description: capital city of West Bengal, India
rows.hook: served as the capital of a colonial empire's south asian territories for over a century

rows.label: Rio de Janeiro
rows.description: city of Rio de Janeiro state, Brazil
rows.hook: is home to a giant statue of a robed figure overlooking the city from a mountain

rows.label: São Paulo
rows.description: largest city of Brazil, and capital of the State of São Paulo
rows.hook: is a sprawling financial hub known for its endless skyscraper skyline

rows.label: Cape Town
rows.description: city in the Western Cape, South Africa
rows.hook: sits beneath a flat-topped mountain overlooking two oceans

rows.label: Cairo
rows.description: capital city of Egypt
rows.hook: sits beside the ancient pyramids and a famous sphinx

rows.label: Alexandria
rows.description: port city on the Mediterranean coast of Egypt
rows.hook: was once home to one of the ancient world's tallest lighthouses

rows.label: Karachi
rows.description: provincial capital of Sindh, Pakistan
rows.hook: served as the country's first capital after independence and is now its busiest seaport

rows.label: Lagos
rows.description: largest city and former capital of Nigeria
rows.hook: is the busiest seaport and most populous urban area in west africa

rows.label: Johannesburg
rows.description: largest city in South Africa
rows.hook: grew out of a gold rush and is called the City of Gold

rows.label: Baghdad
rows.description: capital city of Iraq
rows.hook: was once the center of learning for a medieval caliphate, home to a legendary house of wisdom

rows.label: Dhaka
rows.description: capital and largest city of Bangladesh
rows.hook: is nicknamed the city of mosques and the rickshaw capital of the world

rows.label: Casablanca
rows.description: largest city of Morocco
rows.hook: shares its name with a classic old black-and-white Hollywood film

rows.label: Chengdu
rows.description: capital of Sichuan Province, China
rows.hook: is home to a famous panda breeding and research center

rows.label: Harbin
rows.description: capital of Heilongjiang province, China
rows.hook: hosts a spectacular festival of giant illuminated ice sculptures each winter

rows.label: Lahore
rows.description: capital of the Punjab province, Pakistan
rows.hook: is home to a massive centuries-old fort and a grand mosque

rows.label: Hanoi
rows.description: capital of Vietnam
rows.hook: is known for its atmospheric old quarter and lakeside pagodas

rows.label: Bogotá
rows.description: capital city of Colombia
rows.hook: sits high in the andes mountains as one of the highest-altitude capitals in the world

rows.label: Nairobi
rows.description: capital city of Kenya
rows.hook: is one of the few cities in the world with a wildlife safari park within its limits

rows.label: Nanjing
rows.description: capital city of Jiangsu Province, China, former capital of the Republic of China and China's Ming dynasty
rows.hook: served as an ancient capital for several dynasties

rows.label: Hangzhou
rows.description: capital of Zhejiang Province, China
rows.hook: is famous for a scenic lake celebrated in classical poetry

rows.label: Xi'an
rows.description: capital of Shaanxi Province, China
rows.hook: is home to a buried army of thousands of life-sized clay warriors

rows.label: Ankara
rows.description: capital of Turkey
rows.hook: houses the mausoleum of the nation's founding president

rows.label: Kabul
rows.description: capital and the largest city of Afghanistan
rows.hook: sits in a mountain valley along the ancient silk road trading route

rows.label: Jeddah
rows.description: city in Saudi Arabia
rows.hook: serves as the gateway city for pilgrims heading to Islam's holiest sites

rows.label: Santiago
rows.description: capital city of Chile
rows.hook: lies in a valley ringed by the andes mountains and is surrounded by wine country

rows.label: Lima
rows.description: capital and largest city of Peru
rows.hook: is celebrated as a global hotspot for fine dining and ceviche

rows.label: Pune
rows.description: metropolis in Maharashtra, India
rows.hook: is nicknamed the oxford of the east for its many universities

rows.label: Ahmedabad
rows.description: city in the state of Gujarat, India
rows.hook: was home to the ashram of the leader who championed nonviolent resistance during the independence movement

rows.label: Jaipur
rows.description: capital of Rajasthan, India
rows.hook: is known as the Pink City for the color of its old town

rows.label: Busan
rows.description: metropolitan city of South Korea
rows.hook: is famous for its beaches and a major international film festival

rows.label: Dar es Salaam
rows.description: largest city in Tanzania and capital of Dar es Salaam Region
rows.hook: serves as the main seaport and commercial center on the indian ocean coast

rows.label: Lucknow
rows.description: capital of Uttar Pradesh, India
rows.hook: is famous for its nawabi-era cuisine and delicate embroidered textiles

rows.label: Tianjin
rows.description: municipality of China
rows.hook: grew into a major port city dotted with european-style buildings from its treaty-port era

rows.label: Amman
rows.description: capital of Jordan
rows.hook: was built across seven hills and still has a well-preserved roman theatre

rows.label: Wuhan
rows.description: capital city of Hubei Province, China
rows.hook: sits at the meeting point of two rivers, formed from the union of three older towns
